description: Time tracker widget for Windows 10 and 11: project time tracking and weekly plan vs actual hours on your desktop. One click or a global hotkey starts the timer, idle detection pauses it, analytics show hours per day. Pure PowerShell, no install, no admin, no network.
release_notes:
First public release of the time tracker widget for Windows 10 and 11.

- One knob starts and stops the timer for the active project; up to 5 projects.
- Weekly plan vs actual bars per project, default plan 40 h (Client work 15, Product 10, Learning 5, Admin 5, Other 5).
- Idle detection: auto-pause after 25 minutes without input.
- Global hotkeys: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+9 start or stop, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+1 to 5 switch project.
- Analytics window with hours per project per day, current and past weeks.
- Crash recovery with a 60 second heartbeat. Data stays in %APPDATA%\WorkTracker, nothing is sent anywhere.

Install: unzip, run install.bat. Windows PowerShell 5.1 (built in), no admin rights.
